unsafe_justifications: The public safe entry point calls the private target-feature function only on x86 or x86_64 after the root is_supported function establishes AVX-512F and AVX-512BW support. The root checks OS-enabled state with std and statically enabled features without std.

The private AVX-512 implementation uses one unaligned 64-byte load from a complete borrowed [u8; BLOCK_BYTES] array. No alignment, extra padding, or out-of-bounds access is required. The load has an explicit unsafe block, satisfying the root unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn policy.

AVX-512 byte comparisons use native 64-bit predicate masks and only AVX-512F plus AVX-512BW. Architecture-specific imports and implementation are cfg-gated. The scalar fallback is local, allocation-free, safe, and available on every target.
Tests directly call the private SIMD implementation only after the same CPU and OS support check. Alignment test arrays are created by safe slice-to-array reference conversion.
test_vectors: Exact ten-field literal mask expectations and frozen public function signature.
All 256 uniform byte values, including all-zero, all-high-bit, and unclassified blocks.
Every byte value independently at every one of 64 positions, compared against an independent predicate oracle for scalar, safe dispatch, and supported SIMD paths.
Adjacent masks around positions 1, 8, 16, 32, 48, and 63, plus alternating digit and high-byte masks.
256 deterministic odd-stride byte permutations and 512 fixed-seed mixed blocks.
Whitespace/control overlap and unsigned boundaries at 0x1f/0x20, 0x2f/0x30, 0x39/0x3a, and 0x7f/0x80.
Raw punctuation inside quotes, invalid escapes, invalid UTF-8, and non-ASCII whitespace and digit encodings.
All 64 address offsets modulo vector alignment, exact array references, endpoint masks, and input preservation.
Root assembly integration for lengths 0 through 64, padding clipping, raw-mask preservation, and string exclusion.
Root assembly error paths for lengths 65, 127, 128, 255, 256, and usize::MAX, asserting canonical error metadata and unchanged raw masks. The structural classifier itself has no error path.
